rules.statement: A mortgagor who pays the assignor (mortgagee) in ignorance of an assignment, without notice, is wholly discharged from their obligation. However, a payment made after receiving notice from the assignee not to pay the original mortgagee is not dischargeable.
rules.supporting_quote: The above principle does not apply to the case of payment by a purchaser from the mortgagor. The purchaser must take measures to satisfy himself that the person he pays is entitled to receive the money. Otherwise he pays at his peril.
